Quick release levers on your wheels and seatpost make removing them easy and that makes
stealing them easy.
It only takes a few seconds to remove a quick release front wheel or saddle.
You should replace any quick release levers with allen bolts or 15 millimeter nuts.
If it doesn't mean your wheels and saddles are safe, it just makes them harder for a

If you're using a chain lock too, loop this through the front wheel and around part of
